requiredSeparations.impeccableDesignEngineeringVsProjectAest: Impeccable encodes foundational design engineering discipline (hierarchy, contrast, rhythm), not a single monolithic aesthetic style.
requiredSeparations.detectorRuleVsUniversalDesignTruth: Deterministic detector rules flag specific code patterns; they do not replace human architectural or artistic judgment.
requiredSeparations.impeccablePassVsGoodDesignProof: Passing detector heuristics does not prove an interface is well-designed or functional.
requiredSeparations.impeccablePassVsAccessibilityCertificati: Static contrast/tag checks do not constitute full WCAG AAA certification.
requiredSeparations.impeccableSkillVsExecutionAuthority: Impeccable provides knowledge and heuristics; human developer maintains sovereign execution authority.
requiredSeparations.impeccableInstallerVsKnowledgeSource: The knowledge resides in the design heuristics and markdown specifications, not the npx execution wrapper.

contextArchitecture.productContext: PRODUCT.md (durable product truth, target audience, intent, voice)
contextArchitecture.designContext: DESIGN.md (chosen visual system, design tokens, typography scales, components)
contextArchitecture.surfaceContext: Task/surface specific direction (e.g., checkout page, telemetry dashboard)
